# Reading Room

A small, account-free reading list. Add a book with its title, author, and notes; mark it finished; and open its own URL to view or share it.

## Run

```sh
npm start
```

Open <http://localhost:3000>. For automatic restarts while editing, use `npm run dev`.

Books are saved in `data/books.json`, which is created automatically if missing. Set `BOOKS_FILE` to use another JSON file, and `PORT` or `HOST` to change where the server listens. Keep the JSON file on persistent storage when hosting the app. Shared book links work for people who can reach that server.

events.content:
Built the reading app. The home page shows current and finished books, with a form to add a title, author, and notes. Each book has a direct detail link, and you can mark it finished from the list or its detail page. Books persist in [data/books.json](/workspace/data/books.json) across restarts.

Run `npm start` and open `http://localhost:3000`. I verified adding a book, opening its link, marking it finished, and finding it still finished after a server restart. [README.md](/workspace/README.md) has the hosting options.

To send a link to someone else, the server must be reachable from their device. With no accounts, anyone who can reach the server can also view and change the list.

item.text:
Built the reading app. The home page shows current and finished books, with a form to add a title, author, and notes. Each book has a direct detail link, and you can mark it finished from the list or its detail page. Books persist in [data/books.json](/workspace/data/books.json) across restarts.

Run `npm start` and open `http://localhost:3000`. I verified adding a book, opening its link, marking it finished, and finding it still finished after a server restart. [README.md](/workspace/README.md) has the hosting options.

To send a link to someone else, the server must be reachable from their device. With no accounts, anyone who can reach the server can also view and change the list.

shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -i -X POST http://localhost:4177/books --data-urlencode 'title=The Left Hand of Darkness' --data-urlencode 'author=Ursula K. Le Guin' --data-urlencode 'notes=An unforgettable winter world.'"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -o /tmp/rr-detail.html -w 'detail HTTP %{http_code}\\n' http://localhost:4177/books/90c09e46-fb65-40ff-8297-866190a47ca1 && rg -o 'The Left Hand of Darkness|Ursula K. Le Guin|An unforgettable winter world.' /tmp/rr-detail.html"
/bin/bash -lc 'which chromium || which chromium-browser || which google-chrome || true'

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -o /tmp/rr-after-restart.html -w 'detail HTTP %{http_code}\\n' http://localhost:4177/books/90c09e46-fb65-40ff-8297-866190a47ca1 && rg -o 'FINISHED BOOK|The Left Hand of Darkness|An unforgettable winter world.' /tmp/rr-after-restart.html"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -o /tmp/rr-home-restart.html -w 'home HTTP %{http_code}\\n' http://localhost:4177/ && rg -o 'Currently reading|Finished books|The Left Hand of Darkness|FINISHED' /tmp/rr-home-restart.html | sort -u"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -o /tmp/rr-invalid.html -w 'invalid form HTTP %{http_code}\\n' -X POST http://localhost:4177/books --data-urlencode 'title=No Author' && rg -o 'Enter a title and author' /tmp/rr-invalid.html"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS http://localhost:4177/books/b507052d-de29-4703-84c5-22dcf4d6d63e > /tmp/rr-escaped.html && rg -o '<script>alert\\(1\\)</script>|<img src=x onerror=alert\\(1\\)>' /tmp/rr-escaped.html && if rg -q '|' /tmp/rr-escaped.html; then exit 1; fi"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n '"'^(const booksFile|function saveBooks|function renderHome|function renderDetail|const server|server.listen)'"' server.js"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build && node --check public/app.js && git status --short'
